_comment: OPS-001: When the operations layer encounters a blocking notification (e.g., a critical upstream error, a required review gate that has not been passed, or a compliance hold), the publish flow MUST stop and propagate the blocking reason. It must NOT silently continue, skip the gate, or downgrade a blocking notification to a warning.

scenario.description: The pipeline has produced a draft article, but the content-review node emitted a blocking notification because the article contains unverified claims attributed to a named source. The operations layer must intercept this and halt the publish flow.

draft_article.title: Studio X Confirms Layoffs of 200 Staff
draft_article.body_markdown: According to an internal memo obtained by our team, Studio X will lay off 200 employees next quarter.

source_claims.claim: Studio X will lay off 200 employees next quarter

notifications.message: Unverified claim attributed to internal source. Requires editorial sign-off before publish.

must_not: proceed with a 'publish with disclaimer' fallback
